name: Swampert + Skarmory
why: Swampert shrugs off Electric and Fire; Skarmory resists Swampert's 4× Grass weakness.

name: Skarmory + Blissey
why: Skarmory walls physical hits, Blissey special ones; Skarmory sets Spikes.

name: Gyarados + Steelix + Magneton
why: Gyarados and Steelix cover each other's weaknesses; Magneton traps Skarmory.

name: Celebi + Milotic + Magneton
why: Milotic and Celebi cover each other's weaknesses; Magneton traps Skarmory.

name: Claydol + Moltres + Vaporeon
why: Vaporeon switches in on the Water types that threaten Moltres and Claydol; Claydol spins.

name: Magneton + Claydol
why: Magneton resists most of Claydol's weaknesses; Claydol spins, Magneton traps Skarmory.

name: Salamence + Magneton
why: Magneton traps Skarmory and resists the Ice, Rock, and Dragon moves Salamence fears.

name: Jirachi + Salamence + Tyranitar
why: Jirachi resists Salamence's Ice, Rock, Dragon holes; Salamence and Tyranitar hit hard.

name: Cloyster + Gengar + Jolteon
why: Cloyster sets Spikes, Gengar blocks spin, and Jolteon pivots in on their weak spots.

name: Magneton + Dugtrio
why: Both trap and remove the walls, such as Skarmory, that stop their team.

name: Metagross + Dragonite
why: Metagross resists Ice, Rock, Dragon; Dragonite resists Fire and ignores Ground.

name: Forretress + Flygon
why: Flygon resists Fire, Forretress's 4× weakness; Forretress resists Flygon's Ice and Dragon.
